items.informal_name: Identity of lsum and lsingle Composition for Dependent Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} (S : Type u_4) {M : ι → Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M i)] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Module R (M i)] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι]
  [inst_4 : Semiring S] [inst_5 : (i : ι) → Module S (M i)] [inst_6 : ∀ (i : ι), SMulCommClass R S (M i)],
  (DFinsupp.lsum S) DFinsupp.lsingle = LinearMap.id
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ S $, an index type $ \iota $, and a family of $ S $-modules $ \{M(i)\}_{i \in \iota} $ with commuting scalar multiplications between $ R $ and $ S $, the composition of the linear map $ \text{lsum} $ and the family of linear maps $ \text{lsingle}_i $ yields the identity map on the space of dependent finite support functions $ \Pi₀(i : \iota), M(i) $. This means that reconstructing a dependent finite support function by summing its components inserted via $ \text{lsingle} $ recovers the original function.

items.informal_name: Linear Sum Identity for Single-Nonzero Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} {R : Type u_5} {R₂ : Type u_6} (S : Type u_8) [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : Semiring R₂] [inst_2 : Semiring S] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_4 : Module R M]
  [inst_5 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_6 : Module R₂ N] {σ : R →+* R₂} [inst_7 : Module S N] [inst_8 : SMulCommClass R₂ S N]
  (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (i : α) (m : M), ((Finsupp.lsum S) f) (Finsupp.single i m) = (f i) m
items.informal_description: For any family of $\sigma$-linear maps $f : \alpha \to M \to_\sigma N$, index $i \in \alpha$, and element $m \in M$, the linear sum $\text{lsum} \, f$ evaluated at the finite support function $\text{single}_i(m)$ equals $f(i)(m)$.

items.informal_name: Linear Sum Evaluates to Component Map on Single-Element Insertion
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_3} (S : Type u_4) {M : ι → Type u_5} {N : Type u_6} [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (M i)] [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Module R (M i)] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_4 : Module R N] [inst_5 : DecidableEq ι] [inst_6 : Semiring S] [inst_7 : Module S N]
  [inst_8 : SMulCommClass R S N] (F : (i : ι) → M i →ₗ[R] N) (i : ι) (x : M i),
  ((DFinsupp.lsum S) F) (DFinsupp.single i x) = (F i) x
items.informal_description: For a semiring $ S $, family of $ S $-modules $ \{M(i)\}_{i \in \iota} $, and another $ S $-module $ N $, given a family of $ S $-linear maps $ F_i : M(i) \to N $, the linear map $ \Phi $ constructed by $ \mathrm{lsum} $ satisfies $ \Phi(\mathrm{single}_i(x)) = F_i(x) $ for any $ x \in M(i) $. This states that applying the linear sum map to a function with a single non-zero element $ x $ at index $ i $ yields the result of the $ i $-th component map applied to $ x $.

items.informal_name: Composition of Finsupp.lsum and lsingle Recovers Original Map
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {N : Type u_3} {R : Type u_5} {R₂ : Type u_6} (S : Type u_8) [inst : Semiring R]
  [inst_1 : Semiring R₂] [inst_2 : Semiring S] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_4 : Module R M]
  [inst_5 : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_6 : Module R₂ N] {σ : R →+* R₂} [inst_7 : Module S N] [inst_8 : SMulCommClass R₂ S N]
  (f : α → M →ₛₗ[σ] N) (i : α), (Finsupp.lsum S) f ∘ₛₗ Finsupp.lsingle i = f i
items.informal_description: For any family of σ-linear maps $ f: \alpha \to M \to_\sigma N $ and any index $ i \in \alpha $, the composition of the linear equivalence $ \text{Finsupp.lsum} \, f $ with the single-index embedding $ \text{lsingle}_i $ equals the map $ f(i) $. This establishes that applying the linear sum equivalence followed by the single-index embedding reconstructs the original map at index $ i $.

items.informal_name: Composition of Canonical Linear Maps Embedding Elements at Index x
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq α] (x : α), Finsupp.lcoeFun ∘ₗ Finsupp.lsingle x = LinearMap.single R (fun x => M) x
items.informal_description: For a fixed index $x$ and semiring $R$, the composition of the linear map embedding elements into single-index finite support functions ($\text{lsingle}_x$) followed by the canonical linear map to all functions ($\text{lcoeFun}$) equals the canonical single-function embedding that maps each element $m \in M$ to the function taking value $m$ at $x$ and zero elsewhere. Formally, $\text{lcoeFun} \circ_\ell \text{lsingle}_x = \text{single}_x$ as linear maps $M \to \prod_{\alpha} M$.

items.informal_name: Composition of Direct Sum and Single Embedding is Identity
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {ι : Type x} [inst : Semiring R] (φ : ι → Type i) [inst_1 : (i : ι) → AddCommMonoid (φ i)]
  [inst_2 : (i : ι) → Module R (φ i)] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] (S : Type u_1) [inst_4 : Fintype ι] [inst_5 : Semiring S]
  [inst_6 : (i : ι) → Module S (φ i)] [inst_7 : ∀ (i : ι), SMulCommClass R S (φ i)],
  (LinearMap.lsum R φ S) (LinearMap.single R φ) = LinearMap.id
items.informal_description: For a finite index type $\iota$, semiring $S$, and a family of $S$-modules $\{\phi_i\}_{i \in \iota}$, the composition of the natural isomorphism between the direct sum of linear maps $\bigoplus_{i \in \iota} \text{Hom}_S(\phi_i, M)$ and the space of linear maps $\text{Hom}_S\left(\prod_{i \in \iota} \phi_i, M\right)$ with the single embedding maps results in the identity linear map on the product module $\prod_{i \in \iota} \phi_i$.

items.informal_name: Linear Map Inserting Elements at a Fixed Index in Finite Support Functions
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} {R : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  (a : α) (b : M), (Finsupp.lsingle a) b = Finsupp.single a b
items.informal_description: For a fixed index $a$ and semiring $R$, the linear map $\text{lsingle}_a : M \to \alpha \to_0 M$ sends each element $m \in M$ to the finite support function taking value $m$ at $a$ and zero elsewhere. This map satisfies $\text{lsingle}_a(r \cdot m) = r \cdot \text{lsingle}_a(m)$ for all $r \in R$ and $m \in M$, extending the additive homomorphism $\text{single}_a$ by linearity.

items.informal_name: Linear map from elements to single-index finite support functions
items.type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    {R : Type u_5} → [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → α → M →ₗ[R] α →₀ M
items.informal_description: For a fixed index $a$, this is the linear map from $M$ to the finite support functions $\alpha \to_0 M$ that sends each element $m \in M$ to the function taking value $m$ at $a$ and zero elsewhere. It satisfies $\text{lsingle}_a(r \cdot m) = r \cdot \text{lsingle}_a(m)$ for all $r \in R$ and $m \in M$, extending the additive homomorphism $\text{single}_a$ by linearity.
